name: hangmu
description: Hang MU — root scripts chạy dev cho cả backend (Rust) và frontend (Vite)

scripts.dev:lan: concurrently -k -n be,fe -c red,cyan "npm:dev:be" "npm --prefix frontend run dev -- --host"
scripts.dev:be: cd backend && cargo watch -q -w src -w migrations -w Cargo.toml -w build.rs -x run
scripts.build: npm run build:fe && npm run build:be
scripts.lint: npm --prefix frontend run lint && cd backend && cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy -- -D warnings
